name: Mishe Mokwa trailhead dirt lot on Yerba Buena Rd (Circle X Ranch)
basis: Mountain Project Echo Cliffs 'Getting There': from the 101 take Westlake Blvd (CA-23) south, right on Mulholland Hwy, right on Little Sycamore Canyon Rd which becomes Yerba Buena Rd; 'the trail starts from parking lot on the right (west) side of road' and the approach follows the Mishe Mokwa trail ~40 min, then a brown sign post in the wash marks the climbers trail. Modern Hiker Mishe Mokwa page (via search summary): dirt parking area on Yerba Buena Rd just after a sharp bend, no fee; overflow lot further east. Match by position: named.mjs finds the mapped Mishe Mokwa Trailhead node at 34.11669,-118.92263; the nearest mapped parking lots are w120492196 and w224929576 (both access=yes, fee=no, 40 m apart) ~0.49 km from the node; crag-parking-road-check shows w120492196 sits 0.02 km from Yerba Buena Road (the trailhead node itself is 0.26 km off the road). Chose w120492196 over its twin w224929576. The Sandstone Peak lot (w120390156) was not used: that is the Sandstone Peak trailhead, not the Mishe Mokwa one the text names. Depth 0; sub-areas all have has_parking already.
